0022600094.text: The Atlanta Hawks, 1-0 and first in the Southeast, visit the Charlotte Hornets, also 1-0 and third in the Southeast, for the second game of both teams' seasons. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring) and Kylan Boswell (knee). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Hawks lost 1-3 to the Hornets in the 2025-26 season series, including a 110-107 loss in Charlotte on February 11, 2026.
